newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait firm buys $58.3mln Telekom shares.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait firm buys $58.3mln Telekom shares.

text.p: A Kuwaiti investment firm said on Tuesday it bought on behalf of clients 87.5 million marks ($58.3 million) worth of Deutsche Telekom shares.

Kuwait Investment Company (KIC) official Ibrahim al-Qadi told the Kuwait News Agency his firm was able to meet 70 percent of requests by clients to buy shares in the German phone giant in Europe's biggest ever share launch on Monday.
He said the company had received total client requests worth 125 million marks in the 20 billion mark offering which was five times oversubscribed.
The price of Telekom shares dropped five percent at the close of the market in Frankfurt on Tuesday, dropping to 32.07 marks but well above the issue price of 28.50 marks.
